'''Mark II Power Guards''' were the second model of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] augmented with the [[Power Guard Enhancement System]]. When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]] acquired control of the Power Guard project, he manufactured Mark III Power Guards using [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] and wiped their minds, transforming them into mindless weapons for him to control. Several Mark II soldiers were sent to [[Raid on the SIS safe house|raid]] the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]'s base on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Striking Back" />
